234 uint8_t reserved3;

395typedef struct sChannelScanResults {
396 //The current service set identifier in use by the neighboring WiFi SSID. The value MAY be empty for hidden SSIDs.
397 char ssid[beerocks::message::WIFI_SSID_MAX_LENGTH] = {'\0'};
398
399 //The BSSID used for the neighboring WiFi SSID.
400 sMacAddr bssid = {.oct = {0}};
401
402 //The mode the neighboring WiFi radio is operating in. Enumerate
403 eChannelScanResultMode mode = eChannelScanResultMode::eMode_NA;
404
405 //The current radio channel used by the neighboring WiFi radio.
406 uint32_t channel = 0;
407
408 //The channel utilization measured by the AP.
409 uint32_t utilization = 0;
410
411 //An indicator of radio signal strength (RSSI) of the neighboring WiFi radio measured in dBm, as an average of the last 100 packets received.
412 int32_t signal_strength_dBm = 0;
413
414 //The type of encryption the neighboring WiFi SSID advertises. Enumerate List.
415 std::vector<eChannelScanResultSecurityMode> security_mode_enabled;
416
417 //The type of encryption the neighboring WiFi SSID advertises. Enumerate List.
418 std::vector<eChannelScanResultEncryptionMode> encryption_mode;
419
420 //Indicates the frequency band at which the radio this SSID instance is operating. Enumerate
421 eChannelScanResultOperatingFrequencyBand operating_frequency_band =
422 eChannelScanResultOperatingFrequencyBand::eOperating_Freq_Band_NA;
423
424 //List items indicate which IEEE 802.11 standards thisResultinstance can support simultaneously, in the frequency band specified byOperatingFrequencyBand. Enumerate List
425 std::vector<eChannelScanResultStandards> supported_standards;
426
427 //Indicates which IEEE 802.11 standard that is detected for this Result. Enumerate
428 eChannelScanResultStandards operating_standards = eChannelScanResultStandards::eStandard_NA;
429
430 //Indicates the bandwidth at which the channel is operating. Enumerate
431 eChannelScanResultChannelBandwidth operating_channel_bandwidth =
432 eChannelScanResultChannelBandwidth::eChannel_Bandwidth_NA;
433
434 //Time interval (inms) between transmitting beacons.
435 uint32_t beacon_period_ms = 0;
436
437 //Indicator of average noise strength (indBm) received from the neighboring WiFi radio.
438 int32_t noise_dBm = 0;
439
440 //Basic data transmit rates (in Kbps) for the SSID.
441 std::vector<uint32_t> basic_data_transfer_rates_kbps;
442
443 //Data transmit rates (in Kbps) for unicast frames at which the SSID will permit a station to connect.
444 std::vector<uint32_t> supported_data_transfer_rates_kbps;
445
446 //The number of beacon intervals that elapse between transmission of Beacon frames containing a TIM element whose DTIM count field is 0. This value is transmitted in the DTIM Period field of beacon frames. [802.11-2012]
447 uint32_t dtim_period = 0;
448
449 //Indicates the fraction of the time AP senses that the channel is in use by the neighboring AP for transmissions.
450 uint32_t channel_utilization = 0;
451
452 //This indicates the number of station associated with the BSS. This field is taken from BSS Load IE.
453 uint16_t station_count = 0;
454
455 //LOAD BSS IE is present or absence in scanned BSS. If scanned BSS does not have LOAD BSS IE present then this field will be 0.
456 uint32_t load_bss_ie_present = 0;
457
458 //This indicates whether the results contain spectrum information.
459 uint8_t spectrum_info_present = 0;
460} sChannelScanResults;
